introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.
name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.
name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your left knee forward, and place your left foot on the outside of your left elbow. Drop your right leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your right knee forward, and place your right foot on the outside of your right elbow. Drop your left leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.
name: RUNNER'S LUNGE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your left foot.

Inhale as you lower your right knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your left foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your right foot.

Inhale as you lower your left knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your right foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.
name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

introduce:
Start in a kneeling position with your thighs vertical to the floor. Extend your right leg out to the side with the foot flat on the floor.

Put your left hand on the floor, directly under your shoulder. Inhale the right arm up and over the head with the palm facing the floor.

Hold this position. Inhale to extend and open your torso, exhale to relax and deepen the stretch along your side.
name: HALF CIRCLE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pelvis neutral and stable.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
This exercise stretches the side of your body.
This exercise opens your chest and hips.
Inhale to extend your body. Exhale to relax and deepen the stretch of your side.

introduce:
Start in a kneeling position with your thighs vertical to the floor. Extend your left leg out to the side with the foot flat on the floor.

Put your right hand on the floor, directly under your shoulder. Inhale the left arm up and over the head with the palm facing the floor.

Hold this position. Inhale to extend and open your torso, exhale to relax and deepen the stretch along your side.
name: HALF CIRCLE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pelvis neutral and stable.
Keep your chest facing forward.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
This exercise stretches the side of your body.
This exercise opens your chest and hips.
Inhale to extend your body. Exhale to relax and deepen the stretch of your side.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. 

Inhale, step your left foot forward inside your left hand, and lower your right knee to the floor, then exhale. Inhale, lengthen through the spine. Exhale, rotate your upper body to the left and reach your left arm to the sky. Look at your left hand. 

Hold this position. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to open your chest and hips.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH ARM EXTENDED UP LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If your neck strains, you can keep your gaze neutral.
This exercise opens your shoulders and hips.
This exercise stretches your chest and glutes.
This exercise helps tone your deltoids.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to open your chest and hips.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. 

Inhale, step your right foot forward inside your right hand, and lower your left knee to the floor, then exhale. Inhale, lengthen through the spine. Exhale, rotate your upper body to the right and reach your right arm to the sky. Look at your right hand. 

Hold this position. Inhale to extend your spine, exhale to open your chest and hips.
name: CRESCENT LOW LUNGE WITH ARM EXTENDED UP RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If your neck strains, you can keep your gaze neutral.
This exercise opens your shoulders and hips.
This exercise stretches your chest and glutes.
This exercise helps tone your deltoids.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to open your chest and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back and inhale. Exhale to draw your knees toward your chest, separate the knees, and raise the feet so the soles of the feet are toward the ceiling.

Inhale, grab the inside of your feet. Exhale, gently sink the shoulders and tailbone toward the floor.

Hold the position. Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to soften your hips and lower back into the mat.
name: HAPPY BABY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on the mat.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your hips and lower back.
Keep your head on the mat to avoid neck strain.
This exercise can help relieve your lower back pain.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, hamstrings, groin, and spine.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Extend your left leg backward and land on your toes. Keep your left leg straight. 

Move your body backward until you feel a stretch in your calf. Return and repeat.
name: KNEELING CALF STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your upper body lifted and don’t collapse into your shoulders.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your extended leg straight.
This exercise helps stretch your calf.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Extend your right leg backward and land on your toes. Keep your right leg straight. 

Move your body backward until you feel a stretch in your calf. Return and repeat.
name: KNEELING CALF STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your upper body lifted and don’t collapse into your shoulders.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your extended leg straight.
This exercise helps stretch your calf.

introduce: Bring your chin down to your chest, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen look up towards the ceiling, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: UP & DOWN NODS

tips.text: Please don't turn your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Tilt your head towards your left shoulder, and hold it for a few seconds. \n\nThen tilt your head towards your right shoulder, and also hold it for a few seconds. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit on the mat with your legs crossed. Place the back of your hands on the mat with your fingers facing each other. Shift your weight from one side to the other.
name: WRIST EXTENSOR STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Feel the stretch on your wrists and forearms.
Press the back of your hands flat against the ground.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Sit on the mat with your legs crossed. Place your palms on the mat with your fingers facing your body. Shift your weight from one side to the other.
name: WRIST FLEXOR STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Feel the stretch on your wrists and forearms.
Press the palm of your hands flat against the ground.
Breathe regularly.
If you want to deepen the stretch, slightly bend your elbows.

introduce:
Sit upright on the mat with your left leg extended forward at 90 degrees and your right leg extended backward at 90 degrees.

Ensure your sit bones are firmly grounded on the floor. Your shoulders should be in line with the thigh of your back leg.

Lean your upper body forward while keeping your back straight. Hold for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
name: 90/90 HIP STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Don't hold your breath; breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding it.
Sit upright and avoid slouching to the side.
Drive the knee and ankle of your front leg into the ground.
You should feel a noticeable stretch in your hips and thighs.

introduce:
Sit upright on the mat with your right leg extended forward at 90 degrees and your left leg extended backward at 90 degrees.

Ensure your sit bones are firmly grounded on the floor. Your shoulders should be in line with the thigh of your back leg.

Lean your upper body forward while keeping your back straight. Hold for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
name: 90/90 HIP STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Don't hold your breath; breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding it.
Sit upright and avoid slouching to the side.
Drive the knee and ankle of your front leg into the ground.
You should feel a noticeable stretch in your hips and thighs.

introduce:
Lie on your back. Bring your knees towards your chest and hold them with your hands. 

Draw circles clockwise with your knees several times, feeling a gentle massage on your lower back, then switch direction and repeat.

Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and don't tilt sideways while rotating your knees. Breathe naturally during the exercise.
name: RECLINED KNEE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your lower back is firm on the mat throughout the exercise.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise helps release tightness in your knee joints.
This exercise helps release stress in your lower back.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs bent, and feet flat on the mat, shoulder-width apart. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nAlternate tilting your legs to the left and right. Repeat the exercise.
name: SUPINE WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise can relax your lower back and hips.
